build = r'''
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from lib import *
def build_all(base, save_edit, beta=10.0, theta=0.6, a=0.3, Gain=4.0, kappa=0.5):
    U=np.load('U.npy'); O=np.load('O.npy'); mu=np.load('mu.npy')
    O = O - O.mean(1,keepdims=True)          # each neuron's output exactly centered across classes
    z768=np.zeros(768,np.float32); one768=np.ones(768,np.float32)
    gam=np.ones(768,np.float32); gam[DF]=0
    L='bert.encoder.layer.%d.'
    # ---- layer 0: attention no-op, LN zeroes DF, FFN = detectors writing scores into DF
    save_edit(L%0+'attention.output.dense.weight', np.zeros((768,768),np.float32))
    save_edit(L%0+'attention.output.dense.bias', z768)
    save_edit(L%0+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight', gam)
    save_edit(L%0+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias', z768)
    Wi=(beta*U.T).astype(np.float32); bi=(-beta*(U.T@mu+theta)).astype(np.float32)
    save_edit(L%0+'intermediate.dense.weight', Wi); save_edit(L%0+'intermediate.dense.bias', bi)
    W2=np.zeros((768,3072),np.float32); W2[DF,:]=(a*O.T).astype(np.float32)
    save_edit(L%0+'output.dense.weight', W2); save_edit(L%0+'output.dense.bias', z768)
    save_edit(L%0+'output.LayerNorm.weight', one768); save_edit(L%0+'output.LayerNorm.bias', z768)
    # ---- layer 1: uniform attention, head0 value = DF dims, output back into DF of every token (CLS matters)
    save_edit(L%1+'attention.self.query.weight', np.zeros((768,768),np.float32)); save_edit(L%1+'attention.self.query.bias', z768)
    save_edit(L%1+'attention.self.key.weight', np.zeros((768,768),np.float32)); save_edit(L%1+'attention.self.key.bias', z768)
    Wv=np.zeros((768,768),np.float32); Wv[np.arange(8),DF]=1.0
    save_edit(L%1+'attention.self.value.weight', Wv); save_edit(L%1+'attention.self.value.bias', z768)
    Wo=np.zeros((768,768),np.float32); Wo[DF,np.arange(8)]=Gain
    save_edit(L%1+'attention.output.dense.weight', Wo); save_edit(L%1+'attention.output.dense.bias', z768)
    save_edit(L%1+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight', one768); save_edit(L%1+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias', z768)
    save_edit(L%1+'output.dense.weight', np.zeros((768,3072),np.float32)); save_edit(L%1+'output.dense.bias', z768)
    save_edit(L%1+'output.LayerNorm.weight', one768); save_edit(L%1+'output.LayerNorm.bias', z768)
    # ---- layers 2..11: exact no-ops (only LayerNorm standardization, idempotent)
    for l in range(2,12):
        save_edit(L%l+'attention.output.dense.weight', np.zeros((768,768),np.float32)); save_edit(L%l+'attention.output.dense.bias', z768)
        save_edit(L%l+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight', one768); save_edit(L%l+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias', z768)
        save_edit(L%l+'output.dense.weight', np.zeros((768,3072),np.float32)); save_edit(L%l+'output.dense.bias', z768)
        save_edit(L%l+'output.LayerNorm.weight', one768); save_edit(L%l+'output.LayerNorm.bias', z768)
    # ---- pooler + classifier
    Wp=np.zeros((768,768),np.float32); Wp[np.arange(8),DF]=kappa
    save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.weight', Wp); save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.bias', z768)
    Wc=np.zeros((8,768),np.float32); Wc[np.arange(8),np.arange(8)]=1.0
    save_edit('classifier.weight', Wc); save_edit('classifier.bias', np.zeros(8,np.float32))
'''
open('build.py','w').write(build)
